warnings.message: #@ persist source "west_spend" is not built, so it is answered live: it is built over its upstreams' tables in its storage= destination, which compares strings byte-exact, and the base its strings are read on is not named (its query runs on an inline `extend` or an unnamed query); declare that base as a source of its own and build this one over it by name; a downstream is never built by recomputing its upstreams from raw.
warnings.subject: west_spend
